description: Synthetic examples for group-only Helpdesk correction, dedicated-template/Helpdesk-fallback Mirza intake, and eight explicit jobs with email/UI and key/Tool scopes. No live data or production activation.

confirmed_rules.mirza_fallback_approval_message_template: Mirza request #{ticket_id} awaits your approval: {ticket_link}. Review the request and change its status from On Hold to Open to approve.

mirza_clarification.message_template: Mirza request #{ticket_id} needs clarification: {ticket_link}. Required details: {missing_details}. Add these details in a ticket note and change its status from On Hold to Open so processing can continue.

mirza_completion_notification.message_template: Mirza request #{ticket_id} completed: {ticket_link}. Request: {ticket_description}. Work done: {completion_summary}.

DWE: system administration: email, Active Directory, directory groups and job-title updates, meeting-room bookings
